phases.title: Phase 1: Monolithic MVP & DevOps Fundamentals
phases.description: Development of the ToggleMaster MVP in Python/Flask to manage feature flags in production without requiring new deployments. Implementation of containerization with Docker and Docker Compose, comparative analysis between monolithic and distributed architectures, and design of initial cloud architecture on AWS (EC2, VPC, Security Groups) with DevOps culture best practices.

phases.title: Phase 2: Microservices & Kubernetes Orchestration
phases.description: Decomposition of the monolith into specialized, autonomous microservices (Auth Service in Go, Flag and Targeting Services in Python/Flask, Evaluation Service in Go/Redis, and Analytics Service in Python/DynamoDB/SQS). Multi-stage Dockerfile optimization, local orchestration with Docker Compose, and migration to managed Kubernetes on AWS EKS with declarative manifests (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Ingress NGINX).

phases.title: Phase 3: Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps & GitOps
phases.description: Full automation and infrastructure governance using Terraform on AWS (provisioning VPC with public/private subnets, EKS Cluster, 3x RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis, DynamoDB, SQS, ECR repositories, and S3 remote state with DynamoDB lockfile). Implementation of DevSecOps pipeline in GitHub Actions with security and quality scanning (SonarCloud, Trivy for containers, Hadolint) and continuous GitOps deployments managed by ArgoCD.
skills: Remote State Management with S3 & DynamoDB Lock

phases.title: Phase 4: Full Observability & Active Response
phases.description: Implementation of modern real-time observability stack for ToggleMaster: application instrumentation with OpenTelemetry SDK (OTel Collector via OTLP gRPC), metric collection with Prometheus, centralized logging with Loki, and dynamic Grafana dashboards for latency, throughput, saturation, and error rate. New Relic integration for APM and proactive alerting with self-healing and webhook notifications.
skills: Distributed Tracing & APM with New Relic

phases.title: Phase 5: Final Hackathon — SRE, FinOps & Resilience
phases.description: Consolidation final hackathon designing the high-resilience SolidaryTech platform, comprising 3 heterogeneous microservices (Donation Service in Go with AWS SQS async messaging, NGO Service in Python/Flask with PostgreSQL, and Volunteer Service in Python with DynamoDB). Advanced application of SRE principles (SLIs, SLOs, Error Budgets), FinOps for cloud cost optimization, ITSM practices, contingency, CI/CD pipelines, and Terraform on Kubernetes.
skills: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE - SLIs, SLOs, Error Budgets)
